question_text: A 47-year-old woman comes to the physician because of easy bruising and fatigue. She appears pale. Her temperature is 38°C (100.4°F). Examination shows a palm-sized hematoma on her left leg. Abdominal examination shows an enlarged liver and spleen. Her hemoglobin concentration is 9.5 g/dL, leukocyte count is 12,300/mm3, platelet count is 55,000/mm3, and fibrinogen concentration is 120 mg/dL (N = 150–400). Cytogenetic analysis of leukocytes shows a reciprocal translocation of chromosomes 15 and 17. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment for this patient at this time?
